title: Inspired By The Moon
bodyHtml:
New Lunaris Series

Bold Italian Design

Inspired by the graceful dance of the moon, Lunaris offers a series of striking statement pieces designed to elevate your wash area with its distinctive form and aesthetic.

Discover the Lunaris Series

Versatile. Functional.

Lunaris is available in 4 versatile sizes - 61cm, 81cm, 101cm and 121cm offering clever in-built shelf solutions across the range and the ability to seamlessly pair with the Lunaris Towel Rails in cases of wall-hung installations, providing further space-saving functionality.

Complete the Look - The Lunaris Mirror

The Lunaris Mirror is the perfect complement to the Lunaris Series Basins and Towel Rails, featuring two satellite mirrors that 'orbit' the main mirror, allowing for adjustable placement options depending on your preference.

One satellite mirror emits natural LED light, while the other is a zoom mirror, offering a complete and beautiful mirror solution.

Complete the Look - Lunaris Towel Rails

Crafted especially for the Lunaris basin series, these sleek towel rails for wall-mounted installations, offer space saving functionality and a complete aesthetic when paired with the Lunaris Mirror.

Available in both Matte Black and Matte White.
